reviews.title: 18.2 cu top mount freezer refrigerator
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This seems small to me. I am bending too low to grab things out of the fridge. I prefer the ice maker on the outside of the freezer, because it takes up space in the smaller freezer. With kids the fingerprint resistant finish is good to have. It can be easily cleaned, but overall this seems basic.

reviews.title: ok looking, small
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Plus: fingerprint resistant, ice maker, large shelves, depth inside good Minus: too small for me, like more drawers and dividers and am partial to more door space in fridge Freezer small, don't like hidden handles May be great for an apartment dwelling but not for a family. Or a back up in basement

reviews.title: Kenmore Refrigerator
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Did not Ike too small, seems too low on the shelf. Freedom portion tiny. Won't have room for extras like leftovers or storing ahead for parties.
